description: What proteins a drug acts on — the curated target interactions for a ligand in the Guide to PHARMACOLOGY (IUPHAR/BPS), each with the target PROTEIN NAME, interaction type (Agonist/Antagonist/Inhibitor), action and binding affinity (pKi/pIC50). Pass the drug by name ("imatinib") and it is resolved for you; a GtoPdb ligand id also works. The response always names the ligand it actually read, so an id that turns out to be a different compound is visible rather than silent. Requires a GtoPdb API key — register free at guidetopharmacology.org/login.jsp and pass your own via _apiKey.

ligand.description: Drug/ligand name, e.g. "imatinib". Resolved against the GtoPdb ligand list.

ligand_id.description: GtoPdb ligand id, e.g. 4139 for aspirin. Optional — give this OR ligand.

name: ligand_interactions
title: Ligand Interactions
